name: analysis-specification
title: Analysis specification (ARS) and ADaM spec from an approved TLF plan
description: Turn an approved TLF plan into the specifications that drive computation: one ARS-aligned analysis spec per planned output (population, record subset, variables, methods, rounding), the aggregated ADaM spec that adam-derivation consumes (datasets, parameters, variables, the mandatory derivation rules and the N-gate), and a CDISC ARS ReportingEvent. The AI writes the specs; a deterministic gate validates the ReportingEvent against the ARS LDM JSON Schema and checks every cross-reference (one analysis per planned output, every variable in the ADaM spec, SDTM sources actually delivered); failures go back to the AI, three attempts; the statistician approves or sends the specs back with a comment. Runs standalone (upload) or inside a parent workflow (study package in the trigger).
preamble: CDISC terms (ARS, ReportingEvent, ADaM, ADSL, BDS, OCCDS, PARAMCD, SDTM, analysis sets, ANCOVA, MMRM, LOCF, adverse events, deaths) are technical workflow content.

triggerInput.name: package
triggerInput.description: Study package from a parent workflow: { study, profile, files: [{ name, downloadUrl, kind, sha256 }] } with kinds tlf-plan (tlf-plan.json) and study-model, plus sdtm (for the inventory) and optionally sdtm-define, sap, usdm. Leave empty to upload by hand.

steps.name: Resolve inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. Picks the approved plan, study model, SDTM and context from the study package, or routes to the upload step.

steps.name: Upload the plan and SDTM
steps.description: Upload tlf-plan.json and study-model.json (the approved output of tlf-planning) and the SDTM datasets (.xpt). Optionally the SDTM define.xml, the SAP and the USDM JSON.

steps.name: Stage inputs
steps.description: Deterministic. sha256-verifies the inputs and stages them under /workspace/analysis-specification/inputs with an inventory of what the SDTM holds (codes per domain).

steps.name: Write the specifications
steps.description: AI. Runs the tlf-analysis-spec skill: analysis-spec.json (one entry per planned output), adam-spec.json (datasets, parameters, variables, mandatory derivation rules, N-gate) and reporting-event.json (CDISC ARS). Writes specs only, computes nothing. On a gate retry it fixes the listed problems; on a review round it changes only what the statistician asked.

agent.prompt: You are the study statistician writing the analysis specifications for this run. Read /artifacts/skills/tlf-analysis-spec/SKILL.md now and follow it exactly; its references are in /artifacts/skills/tlf-analysis-spec/references/. Inputs are under /workspace/analysis-specification/inputs/ (read-only); write the three specs to /workspace/analysis-specification/specs/. If /workspace/analysis-specification/feedback.json exists, the deterministic gate rejected your last specs: fix exactly the problems it lists. If /workspace/analysis-specification/review-feedback.jsonl exists, its LAST line is the statistician's change request: change only what it asks. Finish only when `python3 /artifacts/scripts/self_check.py` prints PASS, then write /output/result.json as the skill describes.

steps.name: Check the specifications
steps.description: Deterministic gate: reporting-event.json validates against the CDISC ARS LDM JSON Schema and every internal reference resolves; every planned output has exactly one analysis-spec entry (table_id = final_id) and one ARS analysis AN.<final_id> + output OUT.<final_id>; every dataset and variable an analysis uses is in the ADaM spec; the ADaM spec is what adam-derivation consumes (names, classes, literal PARAMCDs, used_by_tables, mandatory rules, N-gate) and reads only delivered SDTM. Failures go back to the agent (three attempts per review round). On pass publishes the specs and specs.html.

steps.name: Review the specifications
steps.description: Review specs.html from Check the specifications (every output's analysis set, record subset, variables and methods; every ADaM dataset's sources, parameters and consumers) and the JSON files. Approve to publish the specs, or request changes with a comment; the agent changes only what you ask.

params.name: comment
params.description: What to change about the specifications (required when requesting changes).

steps.name: Record the change request
steps.description: Deterministic. Appends the reviewer's comment to review-feedback.jsonl for the agent (and later skill learning) and resets the gate's attempts.

steps.name: Return result
steps.description: Deterministic. outcome = specified (publishes the gate-checked analysis-spec, ars, adam-spec and analysis-spec-view (specs.html) into the study package) or failed (the gate still fails after the last attempt; the agent's files are attached, the package's specs are unchanged).
